items.title: Spatial strategy — catchment and site selection
items.desc: Phase 1 · 4–6 weeks · Mumbai and Delhi NCR

body.label: Question
body.text: Which catchments hold enough of the right consumer to support a 15,000 sq ft store, and what does demand look like at street level?

body.label: Method
body.text: Catchment profiling by income band and measured activity rate, competitor proximity mapping, gym and club density overlay, intercept surveys at shortlisted locations.

body.label: Output
body.text: Ranked site shortlist with demand rationale, catchment-level bottom-up sizing, cannibalisation read.

body.label: Why it matters here
body.text: Given the supply squeeze in section 06d, this is arguably the highest-value single study in the roadmap after the diagnostic.

body.label: Question
body.text: Is "expert guidance" landing as a reason to visit, or as staff standing near shelves? Which zones earn their floor space?

body.label: Method
body.text: Exit intercepts, mystery shopping, zone-level observation, matched competitor store audits.

body.label: Output
body.text: Experience scorecard by zone, conversion friction list, staff capability read.

body.label: Timing
body.text: Run before the Mumbai build-out so the format iterates once rather than three times.

body.label: Question
body.text: What do the 100+ brands need from a new retail partner, what are they getting from Decathlon and the marketplaces, and what makes PlayBlue worth allocating stock to?

body.label: Method
body.text: Depth interviews with brand and distributor decision-makers, terms benchmarking.

body.label: Output
body.text: Partner requirement map, PlayBlue pitch positioning, margin and terms benchmark.

body.label: Question
body.text: Where does the online-to-store promise break, and is 4-hour delivery a purchase driver or an expensive hygiene factor?

body.label: Method
body.text: Journey mapping, conversion-path research, delivery-promise conjoint against live behaviour.

body.label: Output
body.text: Break-point map, willingness-to-pay for speed, channel role definition.

body.label: Question
body.text: What would make an Indian sports consumer join a retailer's community and stay in it, and what data foundation does that require?

body.label: Method
body.text: Membership concept testing, benefit trade-off analysis, comparator teardown including cultpass and Nike Membership.

body.label: Output
body.text: Membership construct, benefit ladder, required data model.

body.label: Note
body.text: The data-model output is worth specifying early even if the programme launches late — retrofitting a customer data layer is far more expensive than designing for it.

body.label: Question
body.text: Which retail technologies materially change PlayBlue's unit economics, and which are demos?

body.label: Scope
body.text: PIM and catalogue, cross-brand sizing and fit, clienteling, inventory allocation, quick-commerce orchestration.

body.label: Output
body.text: Shortlist by layer, build-versus-buy read, sequencing recommendation, reference-call synthesis.

body.label: Question
body.text: What changed this quarter in consumer preference, competitor moves and category demand — and what should change in response?

body.label: Method
body.text: Recurring wave of the Module A instrument plus competitor initiative monitoring.

body.label: Output
body.text: Quarterly deltas against baseline, standing dashboard, board-ready read.

body.label: Why it compounds
body.text: The launch diagnostic becomes wave one. Every subsequent wave measures movement rather than a fresh snapshot, which is what makes a trend line possible for the Series A narrative.

openQuestions: What decision is on your desk right now that a lack of consumer evidence is holding up?
Where is your mandate at PlayBlue, and who else would be in the room on a decision like this?
How is assortment across 100+ brands being decided today — instinct, vendor availability, or data?
Which consumer group is the Bengaluru format actually optimised for? And is the parent-buying-for-child segment deliberately excluded?
What is still open on Mumbai and Delhi NCR — catchment, format, or timing? How are sites being evaluated?
What is the internal answer to “why not vertical integration, like Technosport”?
Which market size number is in the board deck, and where did it come from?
In your Reliance and Arvind years — what research did you buy, and what actually got used?
